main: ^There should be a series of batteries above you that you'll need to use in order to progress. Your I.S.P should explain the rest.
^One of the batteries above us are undamaged.
^However, they run on geothermal energy. If their outer shells are damaged, they cannot function anymore.
^Any energy you transfer into those broken batteries will be drained away completely. You can't get it back. Make careful choices.
^You should be able to proceed, even with the damage caused by the &!;;%;&&$.
